scale_contrast.what_changes: At 2.397 µm the unstable Turing mode is the wall-normal organic-lamella spacing (Yang et al. 2020: 0.5–5 µm in Namibia; up to eight lamellae per wall layer). Eight lamellae span 19.176 µm, inside Grant 1990 shell-layer thickness (8–50 µm). The 104.2 µm rung is the coarser funnel/primordium scale. Diffusivity must drop by (2.397/104.2)^2 = 5.29e-4 if reaction rates are held fixed, because λ ∝ sqrt(D). Successor scale, not modeled here: Yang sub-micrometre Zuunia lamellae and 80–200 nm fibrils.
